buyer_added_terms.text: OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 3.1 Legal Registration and Certifications The Committee considered it necessary for bidders to demonstrate an establish ed catering business presence in Assam and possess the relevant statutory regi strations and quality certifications. Accordingly, the following requirements wer e proposed: a. The bidder shall have a minimum of five (5) years of established business pre sence in catering services in Assam preceding the bid submission deadline, sup ported by valid documentary evidence. b. The bidder shall have its office or operational establishment located in Guwahati City or in any neighbouring district within a maximum radius of 100 k m from Guwahati City. c. The bidder shall possess a valid ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System certificate relevant to its business activities. d. The bidder shall possess a valid Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) licence or registration, as applicable to the nature and scale of the cater ing services, and maintain its validity throughout the contract period. 3.2 Experience and Past Performance The Committee emphasised the importance of prior experience in providing sim ilar catering services and the need to assess the bidder's performance record. Accordingly, it was proposed that: a. The bidder shall have a minimum of five (5) years of experience in providing similar catering services to Government Departments, Government Institutions and Public Sector Undertakings b. The bidder shall submit relevant work orders, work completion certificates an d satisfactory performance certificates issued by the concerned client organisations as documentary evidence of its experience and performance. 3.3 Qualification of Manager/Supervisor The Committee discussed the need for professional supervision of catering oper ations to ensure proper service management, food handling and coordination. It was proposed that: a. The bidder shall deploy a Manager/Supervisor possessing a degree in Hotel M anagement or Hospitality Management from a Government-recognised universit y or institution. b. Documentary evidence of the prescribed educational qualification and deploy

ment of the nominated personnel shall be submitted to the procuring authority. 3.4 Staff Qualification, Medical Fitness and Deployment The Committee noted that the quality of catering services depends substantially on the competence, fitness and conduct of personnel engaged in f ood preparation, handling and serving. Accordingly, it was proposed that: a. The bidder shall deploy adequate numbers of trained and competent personn el to ensure the efficient delivery of catering services. b. All personnel engaged in food preparation, handling and serving shall possess valid medical fitness certificates issued by a competent medical practiti oner, in accordance with applicable FSSAI requirements. c. The bidder shall furnish the required staff details and medical fitness certifica tes to the procuring authority before deployment and comply with applicable la bour laws and other statutory requirements. 3.5 Food Safety, Hygiene and Verification of Documents The Committee stressed that food safety, sanitation, personal hygiene and the authenticity of submitted documents are essential requirements for the delivery of catering services. The following conditions were proposed: a. The bidder shall comply with applicable FSSAI regulations and maintain appro priate standards of food quality, personal hygiene, sanitation, safe food handlin g and waste disposal throughout the contract period. b. All certificates and documents submitted by the bidder shall be genuine, valid and capable of independent verification. c. The procuring authority shall reserve the right to verify the credentials and s upporting documents submitted by bidders and take appropriate action in case s of material misrepresentation, in accordance with applicable procurement rul es and GeM terms and conditions. . 3.
